rules.description: Corporate agreements must identify all parties with registered names, CIN/LLPIN, and registered addresses.
rules.statutory_reference: Companies Act 2013 – S.2(20); LLP Act 2008 – S.2

rules.description: Corporate agreements must specify Indian governing law and jurisdiction.
rules.statutory_reference: Companies Act 2013 – S.6; Indian Contract Act 1872 – S.23

rules.description: Corporate agreements should specify dispute resolution mechanism.
A partnership deed must state each partner's capital contribution and the profit/loss sharing arrangement.
A partnership deed should provide for dissolution / cessation and settlement of accounts.
rules.statutory_reference: Indian Partnership Act 1932 – S.39 to S.44

rules.description: A joint venture agreement must state each party's contribution (capital, assets, or resources).
rules.statutory_reference: Indian Contract Act 1872 – S.10; Companies Act 2013

rules.description: A joint venture agreement must define management, control, and decision-making (board, reserved matters, deadlock).
rules.statutory_reference: Companies Act 2013 – S.166; partnership/JV governance principles

rules.description: A joint venture agreement should provide for exit, transfer of interest, and termination.
